comments.text: What struck me most was how Southwest's original simplicity — one aircraft type, point-to-point routes, quick turnarounds — was itself the strategy, not just a cost trick. Once that discipline slipped, the airline started chasing the same complexity it had once beaten its rivals by avoiding.
